policy: Status planned until code/test evidence exists. Do not auto mark done.

items.title: Bootstrap pnpm monorepo and two Vite React TS applications
items.acceptance: Both apps boot and build; no existing work overwritten
evidence: pnpm build: Admin Studio and Learning Workspace production builds passed
docker build: production images passed for both apps
docker compose dev: both apps returned HTTP 200 on isolated test ports

items.title: Implement shared light-only design tokens, UI components, responsive shells
items.acceptance: 360/768/1280 checked; keyboard focus visible; no dark mode
evidence: Playwright: 6/6 app-shell tests passed at 360, 768 and 1280 px
E2E asserted light color-scheme, no horizontal overflow and honest disabled actions

items.title: Add lint, typecheck, unit tests and CI scripts
items.acceptance: Commands run and fail on deliberate invalid fixture
evidence: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build passed
pnpm quality:negative rejected deliberate invalid TypeScript fixture with TS2322
GitHub Actions workflow added for quality and Docker builds

items.title: Implement lesson v2 schema/validator/typed model
items.acceptance: Sample fixtures pass; invalid enum/timestamp rejects
evidence: @ilp/lesson-schema added with Ajv 2020-12 shape validation and semantic cross-reference/security checks
Vitest validates both v2 fixtures and rejects invalid enum, negative time, duplicate IDs, unsafe paths/URLs and missing assets

items.title: Implement versioned v1 lesson import with warning report
items.acceptance: Fixture migration preserves IDs/media refs; no missing media invented
evidence: migrateLessonV1ToV2 tested against hocweb2026 WEB-FLEXBOX-01 at source revision 230380834630f571775a07424cfbb362b9a72108
Migration preserves source archive, lesson/activity/resource IDs, media refs and starter contents; unsupported simulation and missing sources emit structured warnings

items.title: Implement immutable release and draft model
items.acceptance: Editing draft leaves old release unchanged
evidence: FixtureLessonRepository implements optimistic draft revisions and explicit conflict errors without persistence claims
Vitest proves SHA-256 release snapshot remains unchanged after draft edit and student projection strips correctOptionId

items.title: Create lesson reader with safe Markdown and resource link
items.acceptance: Heading/navigation accessible and XSS test passes
evidence: @ilp/lesson-player renders a React-node Markdown subset without raw HTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Vitest confirms script markup is escaped and active/protocol-relative links are rejected; responsive E2E opens both v2 fixtures

items.title: Integrate real video player, captions, chapters and time hook
items.acceptance: Controls/captions/seek run from actual media.currentTime
evidence: Learning Workspace uses native video controls, optional caption track, validated chapter startSec and media timeupdate
E2E dispatches media timeupdate from currentTime and verifies crossed checkpoint state; missing fixture media shows an honest fallback

items.title: Implement timeline event state machine
items.acceptance: Seek/reload/target mapping deterministic tests pass
evidence: Timeline unit tests cover ordinary playback, forward seek, backward seek, repeatable and non-repeatable events using (previous,next] semantics
E2E verifies refresh resets demo-only state and UI explicitly states persistence is deferred to Slice 5

items.title: Implement quiz and checklist evidence types
items.acceptance: Self cannot approve system/teacher evidence
evidence: Formative quiz records an answer without receiving correctOptionId in the student payload or claiming an official grade
Self checklist is interactive while system/teacher evidence controls are disabled or derived; desktop/tablet/mobile E2E passes
